affine_input_gauge.interpretation: 2D affine private ABI is exactly fixed by three non-collinear semantic-native anchors when noiseless; redundant anchors reduce coordinate noise.

nonlinear_cubic_gauge.interpretation: more anchors cannot remove adapter-class bias; when the adapter family contains the true cubic warp, recovery becomes exact and noisy anchors can be averaged down.

generic_smooth_adapter.private_map: source-specific smooth sinusoidal diffeomorphism + affine map; exact analytic form not supplied to adapter
generic_smooth_adapter.interpretation: generic nonparametric smooth adapter removes the need to know the exact warp family, but semantic-native anchor correspondences are still a real grounding channel.

anchorfree_joint_source_gauge.gauge_family: finite rotation x positive-scale x translation library; no semantic-native coordinate anchors
anchorfree_joint_source_gauge.interpretation: exact coordinate anchors are not logically necessary when the private input gauge lies in a known finite low-complexity family; relation-only active search can identify source while leaving several gauge hypotheses alive.

gauge_family_misspecification.interpretation: closed-world elimination can confidently choose the wrong source when the true gauge is outside the registered family. Independent held-out relation validation converts observed wrong routing into UNRESOLVED in the matched screens.

current_hypothesis: grounding cost is controlled by residual interface-gauge complexity, but safe active identification additionally requires explicit open-world validation that the assumed gauge family can explain held-out behavior.
claim_boundaries: semantic-native anchor pairs are used in adapter-fitting screens
anchorfree positive screen assumes a finite known gauge library containing the truth
OOD validation is deterministic and uses strict zero held-out relation error
